E0952

Comptime budget exhausted (fuel)

What

Comptime budget exhausted (fuel)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Reduce the comptime work or split it so it fits the fuel budget.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0952: tests/ui/comptime_fuel.stderr.

  7 | X: #run spin()

 Why: Compile-time evaluation is bounded to keep compilation finite
 Fix: Increase the evaluator fuel or simplify the evaluated program
